map.NPC正常值：破裂点 ≤ 5-10cm，恢复点 ≤ 7-12cm。NPC>10c: Normal NPC: break point ≤ 5-10 cm, recovery point ≤ 7-12 cm. NPC > 10 cm suggests convergence insufficiency.
map.集合近点过远(>10cm)提示集合不足，常见于阅读疲劳、复视；过近(<3cm)可: A near point of convergence that is too far (> 10 cm) suggests convergence insufficiency, often seen with reading fatigue and diplopia; too near (< 3 cm) may indicate over-convergence. Evaluate together with vergence function.
map.本工具计算为粗略集合需求，未考虑调节-集合联动与隐斜。临床NPC检测应使用调节视: This tool computes a rough convergence demand and does not account for accommodation-convergence linkage or heterophoria. Clinical NPC testing should use an accommodative target/penlight; the result is for reference only.

map.集合近点 NPC 通常 ≤10cm（部分 5–8cm）；若 >15cm 为远退，: The near point of convergence (NPC) is usually ≤ 10 cm (some use 5-8 cm); if > 15 cm it is receded, suggesting convergence insufficiency with reading fatigue and double vision.
map.破裂点（复视）与恢复点（回到单视）都测，恢复点应明显近于破裂点；两者差大提示不稳: Measure both the break point (diplopia) and the recovery point (return to single vision); the recovery point should be clearly nearer than the break point. A large difference suggests instability.
map.NPC 远退怎么办？: What to do about a receded NPC?
map.先做集合训练（笔尖推进/棱镜），无效且伴症状可用底向内棱镜缓解。: Start with convergence training (pen-tip push-up / prism); if ineffective and symptoms persist, base-in prism can relieve it.
map.和集合不足关系？: How is it related to convergence insufficiency?
map.NPC 远退是集合不足核心体征，常伴 AC/A 低与外隐斜，需综合评估。: A receded NPC is a core sign of convergence insufficiency, often with low AC/A and exophoria; comprehensive assessment is needed.
